indicator: Bollinger(n, k): SMA(n) +- k population standard deviations of the last n closes; width = (upper - lower) / mid
note: Expected arrays have one entry per close; NaN (the string "NaN") before an indicator's first value. Values are the correctly rounded doubles of exact rational (fractions) results; Bollinger's square root is taken at 60 digits (decimal). Closes are multiples of 0.25, so every input is an exact double.
